description: Free, fully virtual program with tracks in game design, data science, AI, cybersecurity and web development; 6-7 weeks of self-paced projects. Spring, summer and fall cohorts.
eligibility_text: Girls and non-binary students in grades 9-12, including rising 9th graders and graduating seniors; open worldwide.
notes: Seeded 2026-10-11 by Claude (Roles Plan Task A.7, second round: technical programs).
